// Web-font base64 payloads (woff2), factored out to keep docinfo.html light.
// Shared across all specs (Montserrat + JetBrains Mono). Included by the header;
// resolved into docinfo.html's @font-face rules via :docinfo-subs: attributes.
// (No blank lines: this file is spliced into the document header.)
:font-montserrat-regular: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-montserrat-italic: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-montserrat-bolditalic: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-montserrat-bold: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-jetbrainsmono-regular: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-jetbrainsmono-italic: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-jetbrainsmono-bolditalic: data:font/woff2;base64,
:font-jetbrainsmono-bold: data:font/woff2;base64,
